context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly adds validators and plan modifiers to a Terraform resource schema, using terraform-plugin-framework-validators and plan modifier packages.

checklist.name: Status enum validator
checklist.description: status attribute is Optional String with a stringvalidator.OneOf validator accepting only 'active', 'inactive', 'archived'

checklist.name: Priority range validator
checklist.description: priority attribute is Optional Int64 with an int64validator.Between or AtLeast+AtMost validator constraining values to 1-10

checklist.name: Created_at UseStateForUnknown
checklist.description: created_at attribute is Computed String with stringplanmodifier.UseStateForUnknown() plan modifier so it is preserved across updates

checklist.name: Updated_at without UseStateForUnknown
checklist.description: updated_at attribute is Computed String and does NOT have UseStateForUnknown. It should change on every update

checklist.name: Slug RequiresReplace
checklist.description: slug attribute is Required String with stringplanmodifier.RequiresReplace() plan modifier so changing it forces resource replacement

checklist.name: ID UseStateForUnknown
checklist.description: The existing id attribute has UseStateForUnknown plan modifier since it is a stable computed value

checklist.name: Correct imports
checklist.description: Code imports terraform-plugin-framework-validators packages (stringvalidator, int64validator) and plan modifier packages (stringplanmodifier, int64planmodifier)

checklist.name: All attributes have descriptions
checklist.description: Every attribute in the schema has a Description string
